text.text:
Gobbling through the feast, on a joyous holiday,
In the kitchen we go, wobbling all the way.
Tummies on display, making spirits bright,
What fun it is to indulge & belch with pure delight!

Oh, jiggle bellies, jiggle bellies,
Jiggle all the way!
Bouncing with delight, in the festive light,
Oh, how fun it is to play!

text.text:
Gobbling through the feast, on a joyous holiday,
In the kitchen we go, wobbling all the way.
Tummies on display, making spirits bright,
What fun it is to indulge & belch with pure delight!

Oh, jiggle bellies, jiggle bellies,
Jiggle all the way!
Bouncing with delight, in the festive light,
Oh, how fun it is to play!

text.text: Two and a half years ago we would have reached the 1K+ milestone

text:
, but I thought that would be the biggest we would ever be.

And now today, we have reached beyond my own sanity xD

With over

subscribers, I wanna thank each and every single one of you on this crazy journey.

This community has taught me a lot about myself, inner fears, conquering them, perseverance and sheer determination.

I wish you all happy holidays and a happy new years while the year 2025

text.text: (Our sub count is bigger than that now!)

text:
ends and the 2020's decade is reaching its official halfway mark.

We still have a lot to do for this community, and you guys will be here for it, I promise you guys <3

Onwards and upwards!

♡

✈️ 𝗙𝘂𝗿𝘀𝘂𝗶𝘁 𝗕𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗲𝘀 - 𝗭𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗙𝗼𝗹𝗳 (𝘛𝘦𝘭𝘦𝘨𝘳𝘢𝘮)

✈️ 𝗙𝘂𝗿𝘀𝘂𝗶𝘁 𝗖𝗿𝗼𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗲𝘀 - 𝗧𝗿𝗶𝗽𝗽𝗪𝗮𝗵𝗗𝗼𝗴 (𝘛𝘦𝘭𝘦𝘨𝘳𝘢𝘮)

✈️ 𝗛𝗮𝗻𝗸’𝘀 𝗕𝗼𝗮𝗿 𝗕𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗲𝗹 [𝟭𝟴+ 𝗢𝗡𝗟𝗬] - 𝗕𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗧𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗛𝗮𝗻𝗸 (𝘛𝘦𝘭𝘦𝘨𝘳𝘢𝘮)

💬 𝗙𝗮𝘁𝗳𝘂𝗿 𝗕𝗲𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗕𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝗕𝘂𝗳𝗳𝗲𝘁 - 𝗚𝗹𝘂𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗱𝗕𝗼𝗿𝗯 (𝘋𝘪𝘴𝘤𝘰𝘳𝘥)

🐻 𝗞𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗶𝗧𝗵𝗲𝗖𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗕𝗲𝗮𝗿 (𝘛𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘤𝘩𝘛𝘝, 𝘋𝘪𝘴𝘤𝘰𝘳𝘥 & 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦)

🐍🦇 𝗢𝗼𝗴𝘂𝘀𝗪𝗮𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗴𝘂𝘀 (𝘛𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘤𝘩𝘛𝘝, 𝘉𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘴𝘬𝘺 & 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦)

🐺 𝗠𝗿. 𝗩𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗲 (𝘉𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘴𝘬𝘺, 𝘛𝘦𝘭𝘦𝘨𝘳𝘢𝘮 & 𝘚𝘱𝘪𝘤𝘺 𝘊𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵)

🐰 𝗧𝘆𝗻𝗲𝗠𝗼𝘂𝗳𝗹𝗼𝗻 (𝘈𝘳𝘵𝘪𝘴𝘵, 𝘍𝘶𝘳𝘴𝘶𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘊𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘊𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘵𝘰𝘳 & 𝘓𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘚𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘮𝘦𝘳)
